profile.headline: Software Developer at SDS2
profile.summary: I'm a software engineer working at SDS/2.  I seek opportunities that will lead to my growth as a software engineer.  I'm interested in learning more about real time graphics systems and engineering design tools.

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
Support the SmartPlant Structure module of Smart3D with bug fixes and feature enhancements.  Write test cases for new functionality.  I also interact with support and QA teams to resolve customer issues and ensure test coverage.

Performance regression analysis

.Net API development to help simplify customer facing interface with COM business layer.

Conversion of VB6 content to .Net(C#)

C++, COM, and .Net programming.

positions.title: Temporary Exempt
positions.description: Write test cases and assist senior developers in upgrading functionality of structural modeling features in SmartPlant 3D.

positions.title: Student Specialist II
positions.description: Assist with the development of hardware and software systems.  Involves an array of skills from programming to soldering.

positions.title: Student Specialist
positions.description: Maintain and repair computer systems for university staff, faculty, and students

educations.schoolName: The University of Alabama in Huntsville
